source: Independent offline endpoint fixtures: nonadjacent line end, line start, path start/end, and translated polyline start/end. All authored labels are initially clear of marked tips; enlargement requires bounded movement. Dedicated path/polyline start labels challenge start protection; a 0.9 CTM stage challenges screen projection. CSS-only line/path/polyline controls have no marker attributes; markers come from a shared class rule under an HTML ancestor. Automatic edge/SVG/HTML-ancestor style and class toggles test removal/restoration without resize, followed by idle and HTML timer measurement guards.
